events.title: Napoleon Bonaparte Proclaimed Emperor of the French
events.description: The French Senate adopted the Constitution of the Year XII, proclaiming Napoleon Bonaparte Emperor of the French. He was later crowned in a ceremony at Notre-Dame on December 2, 1804.
events.significance: Marked the end of the French Consulate and the transformation of post-revolutionary France into an empire, reshaping European politics and launching the Napoleonic era.

events.title: Supreme Court Decides Plessy v. Ferguson
events.description: The U.S. Supreme Court ruled 7-1 in Plessy v. Ferguson that racial segregation laws did not violate the Constitution as long as the facilities for each race were equal.
events.significance: Established the 'separate but equal' doctrine, legitimizing Jim Crow segregation for nearly six decades until it was overturned by Brown v. Board of Education in 1954.

events.title: Mount St. Helens Erupts
events.description: Mount St. Helens in Washington State erupted catastrophically after a magnitude 5.1 earthquake triggered a massive landslide. The blast killed 57 people and devastated hundreds of square miles of forest.
events.significance: It was the deadliest and most economically destructive volcanic event in U.S. history and greatly advanced the scientific understanding of volcanic processes and hazard monitoring.

events.title: Helen Sharman Becomes First Briton in Space
events.description: Helen Sharman launched aboard Soyuz TM-12 to the Mir space station as part of Project Juno, spending about a week in orbit.
events.significance: She became the first British astronaut and the first woman to visit the Mir space station, marking a milestone for British participation in human spaceflight.

events.title: Jacqueline Cochran Breaks the Sound Barrier
events.description: American aviator Jacqueline Cochran flew a Canadair Sabre jet past Mach 1, becoming the first woman to break the sound barrier.
events.significance: Her achievement demonstrated women's capabilities in high-performance aviation and added to her record-setting legacy as a pioneering pilot.
